tool.title: Latent Semantic Indexing over a prose graph
tool.description: Find units of a declared prose graph (a library, the skills, the beans, docs) that discuss a query in OTHER words — the vocabulary gap lexical search cannot reach. Each hit is labelled lexical+latent or latent only, and the score is a cosine in the latent space, never merged with a lexical result.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The query, in any words, on STDIN — free text never goes on a command line.

inputs.name: graph
inputs.description: Graph id within the instance, e.g. `library`.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Per graph: the top hits by cosine, each marked lexical+latent or latent only.
